description.narrative: The aim of the project is to support EOLO in their efforts to protect communities from the effects of communicable diseases (such as: Dengue, Chicungunya, Zica, food borne illnesses, different forms of influenza and respiratory diseases as well as COVID-19), educate and prevent the spreading of these diseases. Eolo is proposing a long-term project that not only will have an impact during the current crisis, but that it will change habits in local communities in the long run. The project includes a program with schools to prevent communicable diseases, including improving sanitary conditions and information dissemination. The project also will provide basic equipment and supplies to a local health centre and includes protection of Eolo’s employees.
